component.name: Martensite Widget Catalog
component.summary: Comprehensive widget catalog and developer reference for Martensite

description.p: Martensite is a high-performance reactive GUI framework for Rust. The Widget Catalog provides an interactive showcase of over 250 widgets, layout containers, motion primitives, and design-lint rules with live property inspection.

ul.li: Interactive component exploration across button, text, container, and input families
Live theme switching with dark/light mode and perceptual Oklab color palettes
Built-in design linter diagnostics (WCAG 2.2, ISA-101, NUREG-0700, FAA-HFDS)
Hardware-accelerated WGPU and Vello rendering demonstration

description.p: Distribution & Developer Experience release featuring native packaging, in-app inspector, and design lint bridge.
